title: Patient Care Desk Training: Carry-Forward from Short Manufacturer Copay Card Periods (Savings & Copay Assistance Programs)
content:
The length of the closing period of a Manufacturer Copay Card of the Savings & Copay Assistance Programs, in whole months from its first day to its last day, decides how much of the carry-forward, as held to its limit, carries:

- a period of **6 to 8 whole months** carries that amount times its whole months over 12, rounded to the cent half up;
- a period of **fewer than 6 whole months** carries nothing;
- a longer period (**9 whole months or more**) carries that amount whole.

**How are the whole months counted?** From the period's first day to its last day, complete months only. A period from January 1 to December 31 counts 11 whole months.

**What does a 7-month period carry?** Seven twelfths of the amount held to its limit, rounded to the cent half up.

| Whole months in the closing period | Part carried |
|---|---|
| 0 to 5 | nothing |
| 6 | 6 over 12 |
| 7 | 7 over 12 |
| 8 | 8 over 12 |
| 9 or more | the whole amount |

**Hypothetical amount of $600.00 held to its limit:** a 5-month period carries $0.00; a 6-month period $300.00; an 8-month period $400.00; a 9-month period $600.00.
